analyze.title: Analyze Uploaded Document
analyze.description: Run an Analysis on the uploaded document. The type of analysis performed is automatic and depends on the document type (e.g. irs-form, financial, gov't id)

scan.title: Scan Uploaded Document
scan.description: Scans for Viruses, Malware, Spyware, and other digital threats. Your Institution's subscription prevents disabling this option.
